== Description ==

Players at a Friday Cube Draft table during the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025: [[AJ Hatoum]] (back left, grey T-shirt, clear glasses), [[Chris Wirfs]] (back center, black ''Han Solo'' T-shirt, glasses), and [[Logan Pietig]] (back right, black UWL hoodie). Three foreground and right-side players are cropped or seen only by their hands.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2025-world-championship-seattle, Teacher, 3 October 2025 (13:00 PDT): "AJ, wirfs, & Logan drafting with Brandon, Benji, & Jek". * '''Date:''' 3 October 2025 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' [[AJ Hatoum]], [[Chris Wirfs]] and [[Logan Pietig]]: named in the post and matched by face and clothing to [[:File:2025 World Championship evening game 3 October 22.09.jpg]] and [[:File:2025 World Championship Logan Pietig evening 3 October.jpg]]. The post also names Brandon ([[Brandon Baity]]), Benji ([[Benji Chu]]) and Jek at the table, whose faces are out of frame.
Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
